title: Daily S1/R1 × H1 rejection — continuation-position management

dataset.analysis_timeframe: Daily classic pivots / H1 signal / M1 BID-ASK position-management execution
dataset.price_basis: executable BID/ASK liquidation prices with midpoint structural signal

windows.protected_holdout: 2026 YTD ending exclusive 2026-07-24 — reserved and unopened

hypotheses.market_question: For an existing continuation position already travelling into Daily R1 (long) or S1 (short), does a strong completed H1 rejection justify exiting/reducing continuation exposure rather than continuing to hold?
hypotheses.null: Four-hour continuation return after the S1/R1 rejection is non-negative and/or is not materially worse than matched outer-zone strong-wick continuation.
hypotheses.alternative: Four-hour continuation return after the S1/R1 rejection is negative and materially worse than matched outer-zone strong-wick continuation.
hypotheses.mechanism: If the confirmed structural terminal/exhaustion association has executable position-management value, continuing in the incoming direction after the rejection should destroy value from the observable post-H1 decision point.

method.primary_endpoint: HOLD4 continuation-direction executable return from the post-signal decision quote, normalized by lagged H1 ATR24
method.event_definition: Daily S1/R1 core d<0.20 with directional H1 wick >=30%, observable only at completed H1 close
method.decision_semantics: R1 = existing incoming long; S1 = existing incoming short; EXIT_NOW liquidates at first active M1 quote after H1 close; HOLD4 liquidates 240 contiguous minutes later on the same executable side
method.overlap_rule: primary preserves frozen event population; deterministic 4H same-pair/same-direction cooldown is robustness only
method.unsafe_gap_rule: no weekend bridging; each constituent clock-hour segment must contain an active quote; endpoint requires an active quote within final ten minutes

execution.same_bar: signal H1 must be complete before management decision

promotion_gate: 95% CI upper bound for core HOLD4 <0
95% CI upper bound for core-minus-outer HOLD4 <0
core HOLD4 negative in development and validation
at least 7/10 pair-level core effects negative

holdout.protected_window: 2026 YTD ending exclusive 2026-07-24 — reserved and unopened
holdout.prior_exposure: 2015-2025 had prior exposure in related pivot research; management decision semantics were preregistered before management-outcome inspection.

provenance.notes: 2026 YTD conditional on a strict internal promotion gate; the gate failed and the holdout remained sealed.
